# J502 selection provenance

[SOURCES.json](SOURCES.json) records the manufacturer documents and live records
used for the two harness proposals, plus screened alternatives. All use is
**REFERENCED**; no upstream PCB or circuit was copied or modified.

Manufacturer copyrights remain with TE Connectivity, Phoenix Contact, Molex,
Belden, Amphenol/FCI, JST and Samtec. No redistribution licence is assumed.
Downloaded, unmodified review PDFs and temporary text extraction remain in the
existing ignored `third_party/documents/j502_selection/` cache. They are not
committed. Exact hashes are recorded only for successful PDF downloads; web-only
review and inaccessible/image-only documents are identified explicitly.

The authored report and calculations are under `docs/evidence/r2/`. Source URLs,
document identities/revisions and manufacturer attribution are retained for
review and retrieval. The inherited Harwin audit remains in
`third_party/footprints_complete/connector_sources.json`.
